answer: Before a claim pays, the protocol selects an established witness beyond a minimum graph horizon and assigns a short live challenge. You and that witness must complete the exchange in a public meadow timeslot and publish the signed transcript on the zephyr board, where any peer can check the witness, the slot, and the signatures. Extra identities each need their own successful round; one operator cannot cover overlapping slots. Limitation: colluding witness rings can rubber-stamp clones, so a witness who endorses a later-proven farm is slashed.
